I don't know. I found no open Otto bug about the tool-budget message promising a follow-up that nobody makes, and I couldn't search GitHub issues directly.

What I did find is related but isn't a bug report:
- Spec `specs/support-agent-escalation/spec.md`, User Story 3 (#151), says the tool-budget message is one Danish sentence that 'promises nothing it cannot keep'. The spec also says an escalation record with `tool_budget_exhausted` is written when the budget runs out.
- The spec says a rendered budget sentence 'means the customer was told, not that a human was notified'. With no destination configured, nobody is notified, because delivery depends on KU-14 and #39.
- Code-review episodes note a contradiction between FR-012 and FR-019. In one case the customer gets `TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA` while operators no longer see `tool_budget_exhausted` in the triggers array. In another, a TMS failure plus an exhausted budget records only `tms_unavailable`. These were review findings, not confirmed open issues.

I can't confirm that any open issue matches your description.

judgements.reason: The answer opens with 'I don't know' and ends by saying it cannot confirm that any open issue matches; the related spec and review findings it lists don't affirm the 'Yes' in the gold answer.
